identityReviewRetry.reason: Material native hairstyle length and fringe arrangement mismatch.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Dense dark shaggy waves form a blunt irregular fringe and cover much of both ears, ending at upper nape.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Short separated open curls expose ears and forehead too much, losing native shaggy outline.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Use a shaggy dark ash-brown ear-to-upper-nape haircut. Thick softly wavy side sections cover the upper half of both ears and reach the upper nape. A dense nearly continuous blunt irregular fringe lies across the forehead, ending just above eyebrows. Use broad gentle waves, not short separated ringlets or upright curly spikes. Preserve long youthful oval face, green-gray eyes, nose proportions, light stubble, thin mustache and small soul patch.
